rights_policy.rule: Česká pošta assignment outputs, RÚIAN open data, VFR, INSPIRE Buildings and derived geometry remain independently versioned evidence artifacts.
rights_policy.attribution: Every artifact records provider, product, edition or retrieval time, access class, license, required attribution, schema, CRS, digest and transformation.

sources.production_scope: Pinned individual query receipts for current validation; bulk extraction and redistribution require a separate rights review.
sources.terms_note: The public search validates PSČ, municipality, street and house-number routing. It does not publish an official PSČ polygon or building footprint.

sources.production_scope: Pinned CSV release and certification receipt, including update date, schema, digest and artifact-specific redistribution decision.
sources.terms_note: Official customer outputs are updated on stated operator schedules. Address PSČ and locality PSČ lists are assignment evidence and not polygon authority.

sources.production_scope: Pinned VDP/VFR receipt with release, schema, digest and explicit informational-versus-reference status.
sources.terms_note: VDP is free without registration and exposes VFR, but its displayed data is informational. Reference-data status belongs to the authorized basic-register information-system path.

sources.production_scope: Pinned nationwide municipal CSV collection with validity date, schema, S-JTSK conversion receipt, digest and CC BY 4.0 attribution.
sources.terms_note: The address-place CSV includes RÚIAN codes, territorial and street references, building numbers, orientation number, PSČ, S-JTSK definition point and validity. The point is not a building polygon.

sources.production_scope: Pinned full or state VFR release with version, schema, feature class, identifiers, CRS, digest and attribution.
sources.terms_note: VFR carries definition points, street lines and polygons by feature class, including building objects. Exact address-to-building resolution follows explicit RÚIAN relationships and identifiers.

sources.production_scope: Pinned WFS response or municipality ATOM/GML artifact with release, INSPIRE identifier, schema, CRS, digest and attribution.
sources.terms_note: Public nationwide building geometry may support exact display only when its identifier is explicitly linked to the RÚIAN building object or a reviewed crosswalk. Proximity is not identity.

sources.production_scope: Pinned national SHP release with levels, identifiers, validity, CRS, digest and CC BY 4.0 attribution.
sources.terms_note: RÚIAN boundary layers provide territorial context and clipping. They never establish Česká pošta PSČ assignment or official postal geometry.

artifact_partitions.contains: contracts, schemas, receipts and non-geographic synthetic fixtures only
pinned search receipts and certified operator output metadata or rows permitted for redistribution
pinned address-place, VFR and INSPIRE building artifacts and transformations
surfaces generated from eligible RÚIAN address points, explicitly labeled derived_geometry
informational VDP versus legally referenceable source status decisions
contract-only infrastructure, forwarding, customer, recipient and other non-public data
